subject: Your Support Ticket #$ticket_id Has Been Assigned
body:
Dear $student_name,

Good news! Your support ticket has been assigned to a staff member.

==================================================
TICKET ASSIGNMENT NOTIFICATION
==================================================

Ticket Details:
---------------
Ticket ID: #$ticket_id
Title: $ticket_title
Category: $category
Priority: $priority

Assignment Details:
-------------------
Assigned To: $assigned_to
Assigned On: $assigned_date
Expected Response: Within $sla_hours hours

==================================================

What Happens Next:
- $assigned_to will review your ticket
- You will receive a response within our service level agreement
- Any updates will be sent to your email

If you have additional information to add, please log into the Student Portal and update your ticket.

Best regards,
University Student Support Team

$signature
